test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 14 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. B sits third to the left of C. F sits second to the left of E. B is not an immediate neighbour of E. D sits to the immediate right of A. What is the position of B with respect to G?
solution:
Given: A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

1) B sits third to the left of C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fc4004d93d612ba7d9e0017efaaa0268194b86513aa7e4c5fa318d4cb12056df.png] 

2) F sits second to the left of E.

3) B is not an immediate neighbour of E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8b1fc1ac4aeb029699736895e8ffb37ffb7af744b757c58056cd874e80b310f4.png] 

4) D sits to the immediate right of A. 

After positioning A and D only one position is left which will be occupied by the only person left i.e. G.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/09349d24280f78dbae18a7933a2df9289448f0d66e76fec67d5c51711c302b3b.png] 

Thus, B is to the immediate left of G.

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.
